1. Quota-Based Best Clustering

# TRAIN: QUOTA-BASED BEST CLUSTERING

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# uses best clustering space: kmeans_compact_v2, k = 8

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(
      sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

dept_share <- long_data %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments
  )

model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

kmeans_train_v2 <- basket_data %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    avg_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    items_per_department,
    price_deviation
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_kmeans_v2_raw <- kmeans_train_v2 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_kmeans_v2 <- scale(X_kmeans_v2_raw)

set.seed(123)
kmeans_model_v2 <- kmeans(
  X_kmeans_v2,
  centers = 8,
  nstart = 20,
  iter.max = 100
)

kmeans_train_v2$cluster_id <- kmeans_model_v2$cluster
centers_v2 <- kmeans_model_v2$centers

assigned_distances_v2 <- map2_dbl(
  split(as.data.frame(X_kmeans_v2), seq_len(nrow(X_kmeans_v2))),
  kmeans_model_v2$cluster,
  ~ {
    row_vec <- as.numeric(.x[1, ])
    center_vec <- centers_v2[.y, ]
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  }
)

kmeans_train_v2$distance_to_centroid <- assigned_distances_v2

cluster_sizes_v2 <- table(kmeans_model_v2$cluster)

kmeans_train_v2 <- kmeans_train_v2 %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_size = as.numeric(cluster_sizes_v2[as.character(cluster_id)])
  )

quota_tbl <- kmeans_train_v2 %>%
  dplyr::count(cluster_id, name = "n_cluster") %>%
  mutate(
    quota_raw = round(150 * n_cluster / sum(n_cluster)),
    quota = pmax(10, pmin(35, quota_raw))
  )

quota_tbl$quota[which.max(quota_tbl$n_cluster)] <-
  quota_tbl$quota[which.max(quota_tbl$n_cluster)] + (150 - sum(quota_tbl$quota))

quota_ranked <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(
    kmeans_train_v2 %>%
      select(transaction_id, cluster_id, cluster_size, distance_to_centroid),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(quota_tbl %>% select(cluster_id, quota), by = "cluster_id") %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_centroid), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(cluster_rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

quota_selected <- quota_ranked %>%
  filter(cluster_rank <= quota)

if (nrow(quota_selected) < 150) {
  leftover <- quota_ranked %>%
    filter(!transaction_id %in% quota_selected$transaction_id) %>%
    arrange(desc(distance_to_centroid)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 150 - nrow(quota_selected))
  quota_selected <- bind_rows(quota_selected, leftover)
}

top_150_kmeans_quota_train <- quota_selected %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_centroid)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_kmeans_quota_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_kmeans_quota_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_quota_train$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_kmeans_quota_train$distance_to_centroid)
table(top_150_kmeans_quota_train$cluster_id)

write.csv(
  top_150_kmeans_quota_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_kmeans_quota_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
# CASE31: QUOTA-BASED BEST CLUSTERING

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

case31_lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/case31.csv", warn = FALSE)

case31_raw <- tibble(
  raw_line = case31_lines
) %>%
  mutate(
    transaction_id = stringr::str_extract(raw_line, "(?<=Transaction\\s)\\d+"),
    transaction_id = as.integer(transaction_id),
    basket = stringr::str_remove(raw_line, "^Transaction\\s+\\d+:")
  )

case31_long <- case31_raw %>%
  select(transaction_id, basket) %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = stringr::str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

case31_basket <- case31_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(
      sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

case31_dept_share <- case31_long %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case31_basket <- case31_basket %>%
  left_join(case31_dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments,
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = .),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

kmeans_case31 <- case31_basket %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    avg_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    items_per_department,
    price_deviation
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(kmeans_train_v2$price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(kmeans_train_v2$sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(kmeans_train_v2$max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(kmeans_train_v2$top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(kmeans_train_v2$dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(kmeans_train_v2$items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(kmeans_train_v2$price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_case31_raw <- kmeans_case31 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_case31 <- scale(
  X_case31_raw,
  center = attr(X_kmeans_v2, "scaled:center"),
  scale = attr(X_kmeans_v2, "scaled:scale")
)

case31_distances <- apply(X_case31, 1, function(row_vec) {
  dists <- apply(centers_v2, 1, function(center_vec) {
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  })
  min(dists)
})

case31_clusters <- apply(X_case31, 1, function(row_vec) {
  dists <- apply(centers_v2, 1, function(center_vec) {
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  })
  which.min(dists)
})

kmeans_case31$cluster_id <- case31_clusters
kmeans_case31$cluster_size <- as.numeric(cluster_sizes_v2[as.character(case31_clusters)])
kmeans_case31$distance_to_centroid <- case31_distances

quota_case31 <- case31_basket %>%
  left_join(
    kmeans_case31 %>%
      select(transaction_id, cluster_id, cluster_size, distance_to_centroid),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(quota_tbl %>% select(cluster_id, quota), by = "cluster_id") %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_centroid), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(cluster_rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

quota_case31_selected <- quota_case31 %>%
  filter(cluster_rank <= quota)

if (nrow(quota_case31_selected) < 150) {
  leftover <- quota_case31 %>%
    filter(!transaction_id %in% quota_case31_selected$transaction_id) %>%
    arrange(desc(distance_to_centroid)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 150 - nrow(quota_case31_selected))
  
  quota_case31_selected <- bind_rows(quota_case31_selected, leftover)
}

top_150_kmeans_quota_case31 <- quota_case31_selected %>%
  arrange(desc(distance_to_centroid)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_kmeans_quota_case31$total_items)
summary(top_150_kmeans_quota_case31$total_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_quota_case31$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_kmeans_quota_case31$distance_to_centroid)
table(top_150_kmeans_quota_case31$cluster_id)

writeLines(as.character(top_150_kmeans_quota_case31$transaction_id))

write.csv(
  top_150_kmeans_quota_case31,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_kmeans_quota_case31.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

2. Cluster-Local IF

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# TRAIN: BEST CLUSTERING + CLUSTER-LOCAL ANOMALY
# uses same kmeans_compact_v2
# final = 0.85 clustering + 0.15 local anomaly

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                              sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

dept_share <- long_data %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments
  )

model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

kmeans_train_v2 <- basket_data %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    avg_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    items_per_department,
    price_deviation
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_kmeans_v2_raw <- kmeans_train_v2 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_kmeans_v2 <- scale(X_kmeans_v2_raw)

set.seed(123)
kmeans_model_v2 <- kmeans(
  X_kmeans_v2,
  centers = 8,
  nstart = 20,
  iter.max = 100
)

kmeans_train_v2$cluster_id <- kmeans_model_v2$cluster
centers_v2 <- kmeans_model_v2$centers

assigned_distances_v2 <- map2_dbl(
  split(as.data.frame(X_kmeans_v2), seq_len(nrow(X_kmeans_v2))),
  kmeans_model_v2$cluster,
  ~ {
    row_vec <- as.numeric(.x[1, ])
    center_vec <- centers_v2[.y, ]
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  }
)

kmeans_train_v2$distance_to_centroid <- assigned_distances_v2

cluster_stats <- kmeans_train_v2 %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  summarise(
    local_dist_mean = mean(distance_to_centroid),
    local_dist_sd = sd(distance_to_centroid),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    local_dist_sd = ifelse(is.na(local_dist_sd) | local_dist_sd == 0, 1e-6, local_dist_sd)
  )

local_train <- kmeans_train_v2 %>%
  left_join(cluster_stats, by = "cluster_id") %>%
  mutate(
    local_anomaly = (distance_to_centroid - local_dist_mean) / local_dist_sd,
    local_anomaly = pmax(local_anomaly, 0),
    local_anomaly_01 = percent_rank(local_anomaly),
    distance_to_centroid_01 = percent_rank(distance_to_centroid),
    final_local_combo =
      0.85 * distance_to_centroid_01 +
      0.15 * local_anomaly_01
  )

top_150_cluster_local_train <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(
    local_train %>%
      select(
        transaction_id,
        cluster_id,
        distance_to_centroid,
        local_anomaly,
        final_local_combo
      ),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(final_local_combo)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_cluster_local_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_cluster_local_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_cluster_local_train$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_cluster_local_train$distance_to_centroid)
summary(top_150_cluster_local_train$local_anomaly)
table(top_150_cluster_local_train$cluster_id)

write.csv(
  top_150_cluster_local_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_cluster_local_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

    price_per_second = ifelse(
      sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

case32_dept_share <- case32_long %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case32_basket <- case32_basket %>%
  left_join(case32_dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments,
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = .),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

kmeans_case32 <- case32_basket %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    avg_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    items_per_department,
    price_deviation
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(kmeans_train_v2$price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(kmeans_train_v2$sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(kmeans_train_v2$max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(kmeans_train_v2$top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(kmeans_train_v2$dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(kmeans_train_v2$items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(kmeans_train_v2$price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_case32_raw <- kmeans_case32 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_case32 <- scale(
  X_case32_raw,
  center = attr(X_kmeans_v2, "scaled:center"),
  scale = attr(X_kmeans_v2, "scaled:scale")
)

case32_distances <- apply(X_case32, 1, function(row_vec) {
  dists <- apply(centers_v2, 1, function(center_vec) {
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  })
  min(dists)
})

case32_clusters <- apply(X_case32, 1, function(row_vec) {
  dists <- apply(centers_v2, 1, function(center_vec) {
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  })
  which.min(dists)
})

case32_local <- case32_basket %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_id = case32_clusters,
    distance_to_centroid = case32_distances
  ) %>%
  left_join(cluster_stats, by = "cluster_id") %>%
  mutate(
    local_anomaly = (distance_to_centroid - local_dist_mean) / local_dist_sd,
    local_anomaly = pmax(local_anomaly, 0),
    local_anomaly_01 = percent_rank(local_anomaly),
    distance_to_centroid_01 = percent_rank(distance_to_centroid),
    final_local_combo =
      0.85 * distance_to_centroid_01 +
      0.15 * local_anomaly_01
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(final_local_combo))

top_150_cluster_local_case32 <- case32_local %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_cluster_local_case32$total_items)
summary(top_150_cluster_local_case32$total_price)
summary(top_150_cluster_local_case32$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_cluster_local_case32$distance_to_centroid)
summary(top_150_cluster_local_case32$local_anomaly)
table(top_150_cluster_local_case32$cluster_id)

writeLines(as.character(top_150_cluster_local_case32$transaction_id))

write.csv(
  top_150_cluster_local_case32,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_cluster_local_case32.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
